Log observable robot address, intent, Muse task plan, screenshot request, Meta usage, segmentation results, navigation and completion.

Use saved scene labels and coordinates for robot navigation; missing targets/clips report limitations without claiming autonomous perception.

The follow camera tracks selected moving robots without stealing arrow-key locomotion or moving the XR headset camera.
OrbitControls drag updates the follow offset; numpad camera presets are respected; camera mode persists locally and sends no network traffic.

Visible + 3D Model import button, Shift+A model entry and full-stage GLB/FBX drag-and-drop overlay with drop-location placement and size checks.
Robot strafe-speed control 0.5×–4×, independently of walking speed, synced as compact remote movement packets.
Experimental optional Rapier world physics with dynamic/static/kinematic bodies; per-object collider mode, friction, restitution. Off by default.
Drop .glb/.fbx onto world canvas or import from World tools/Shift+A; model uploads stored once and referenced across rooms.
Personal upload cap in Settings: 100 KB–20 MiB, plus strict 20 MiB server maximum.
Remote robot movement uses low-bandwidth inputs, client prediction and smoothed position/yaw corrections.
Correct inverted idle avatar strafing: Left moves visually left and Right moves visually right, without turning in place.
Synchronize correct left/right strafe animations for locally controlled and remote avatars.
Preserve forward bicycle steering, reverse walking and compact network movement messages.
Idle left/right robot strafing with smoothed acceleration, model animation mixer blend and real GLB clip action selector.
Room-scoped world settings for independently open/owned editing of geometry and robots (open by default).

Rename selected objects, delete via scene list, correct overlapping avatar gallery cards.
Fix swapped left/right robot steering by calibrating signed keyboard intent across local and networked movement.
Retains speed-dependent turning, smooth acceleration, reverse walk animation without rotating the avatar, and camera lock while robot is selected.
Arrow-left steers avatar facing left, arrow-right steers facing right while moving; heading remains forward-oriented in reverse.
Arrow-down progressively brakes and moves backward with the SAME walk clip played with reverse time, without a 180-degree turn.
Smooth acceleration/deceleration for robot throttle, steering and desktop camera translations.
Numpad perspectives 1/3/7 and incremental views preserve exact camera distance from selected object; use +/- to zoom.
Consistent button typography and 30px square close, minimize, and expand controls with accessible focus states.
Retains object-specific multiplayer changes, avatar library, room-based WebSocket, shared Whisper.cpp and existing watcher workflow.
Camera +/- zoom is centred on selected object; Blender-style numeric views unaffected.
Duplicated objects receive next available numeric copy suffix and appear above the source.
Robot arrows control signed forward/reverse velocity and bicycle steering dependent on motion speed. Down brakes before reversing; no instant 180 turn.
Camera arrows do not conflict with robot arrow controls; backward clip plays reversed fallback; prediction remains lightweight.
Camera orbit no longer spins on pointer hover; locks during gizmo gestures, no damping drift, selected-object orbit pivot and arrow-key camera translation.
Blender-style numeric perspectives: 1 front, 3 side, 7 top, Ctrl reverse, 2/4/6/8 incremental orbit, 0 home, 9 opposite, 5 refocus.
Undo/redo via Cmd/Ctrl+Z and Shift+Cmd/Ctrl+Z or Ctrl+Y; 120 object command history; shared object-specific updates.
Shift+D clones above original bounding volume rather than overlapping existing geometry.
Objects window draggable at its title; CSS no longer pins its top-left coordinates.
Avatar gallery previews fill each card with image and bottom-left gradient-backed name/metadata.
No WASD/QE camera movement conflicts with Blender editor shortcuts.
Desktop camera: left-drag orbit, right-drag pan, wheel zoom, directional keyboard movement, optional pointer-lock fly mode and configurable camera speed.
Robots: adjustable per-avatar movement speed, arrow-down 180-degree turnaround with reverse-walk clip fallback, left/right strafing, airborne directional jumping; small movement packets.
Reorganised navigation and draggable vertical World tools; Add menu appears at pointer and dismisses on outside click; minimized draggable Objects list.
